description: Run a scenario analysis: compute PnL for multiple price-change percentages at once. Use when user asks "show me my P&L if BTC moves -10%, -5%, +5%, +10%". Returns: array of { deltaPct, exitPrice, netPnl, roe }.

contractType.description: linear = USDT-margined (default), inverse = coin-margined. For inverse, size is USD contracts and pnl/fees come out in the base coin.

deltasPct.description: List of price change percentages, e.g. [-10, -5, 0, 5, 10]

name: workflow.run_scenario_planning
